name: Symbotic (SYM)
teaser: Do not add. The shares trade about 41% above the Base value. One customer provides almost 90% of revenue, stock compensation absorbs a large share of the profits, and the valuation methods diverge sharply, so a 50% margin of safety is required. The buy zone starts at $15.65.
llms: AI-enabled warehouse automation company with $22.5 billion of backlog, about 87% customer concentration and an Up-C structure of about 605 million economic shares, valued on forward EV to revenue and EBITDA after stock compensation. Bear $23.44, Base $31.30, Bull $52.02. Verdict HOLD at $44.04 (do not add), maximum buy price $15.65.
